summary: Russia launched a massive combined strike overnight July 30 involving 358 air attack means (74 missiles, 284 drones) targeting Kyiv, Lviv, and seven other Ukrainian regions; Ukrainian air defense intercepted 320 targets but confirmed hits on 20 locations. Simultaneously, Ukrainian drones struck two major Wildberries logistics hubs deep inside Russia — in Penza (90,000 sq m) and Sarapul, Udmurtia (75,000 sq m, 1,200 km from front) — causing large fires and critical damage. Russian forces also liberated Krasnoyarskoye in the DNR and Svetloe near Dobropillya, advancing in Donetsk region.
key_points: Russia executed a massive combined strike July 30 with 358 air attack means (74 missiles, 284 drones) across 9 Ukrainian regions, intercepting 320 targets but hitting 20 locations. (Source: @eRadarrua/103266)
Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics hub in Penza using >15 FP-1 model drones, igniting a fire across 90,000 sq m. (Source: @eRadarrua/103282)
Ukrainian drone hit Wildberries hub in Sarapul, Udmurtia, 1,200 km from front, causing critical damage to 75,000 sq m facility. (Source: @eRadarrua/103271)
Russian forces liberated Krasnoyarskoye in DNR and Svetloe near Dobropillya per MoD and leak reports. (Source: @tass_agency/387859, @ukr_leaks_eng/32011)

Russian strikes hit Ukrainian defense industry: Kyiv artillery plant (FP-1/2 accelerators), Rivneazot (FP-5 components), Lviv LORTA (Neptune-MD electronics), Ivano-Frankivsk Flamingo missile production. (Source: @tass_agency/387837, @tass_agency/387836)
Russian drones attacked three vessels in Black Sea operating for Ukrainian Armed Forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32037)

Energy infrastructure heavily damaged: Ukrenergo reports critical situation in Sumy, new restrictions in 5 regions; SBS claims 164 energy targets hit in occupied territories July 1-29. (Source: @UkraineNow/83021, @UkraineNow/83001)
Unidentified object fell in Poland's Lublin Voivodeship during attack, creating 10m crater; video shows Poland did not intercept Russian missile. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32035, @eRadarrua/103279)
